The fix is a combination of refund bridge (+5), merged anchor, cost-6 duelists, medic deletion, battery cycles arriving from ~frame 1070, and at most one conditional shoulder concession (route-8).
revised_stage_understanding.c07_engagement_unknown: SC_01's covered cells are only [8,0],[8,5],[9,5]; if C07 uterers (3500 HP, 100 def, speed 1.7) are truly engaged for only one cell, no supplied unit kills them in one window, contradicting one_resource_plausible=true. Exact per-route engagement geometry must come from the verifier; the life budget (planned concession 1 of 5) is the hedge.
revised_stage_understanding.device_unknowns: trap_020_roadblock#2 sits ON [9,2] (8000 HP, 200 def): whether the tile is deployable, or must be cleared first, is unresolved and is the single most important verifier question since C07 has no other coverage. The roadblock at [3,1] plausibly diverts C04's path through SC_03-covered cells, which may be why cluster C04 is marked one_resource_plausible=true.
revised_stage_understanding.duelist_discovery: char_4155_talr (cost 6, 1530 HP, 485 atk, 258 def, 1.0s interval, 25s redeploy) and char_455_nothin (cost 6, 1534/474/262) solo both enemy archetypes at supplied stats: vs uterer they deal ~375-385/hit (kill in ~10 hits) while taking ~118-122/hit (survive ~12-13 hits); vs uoffcr the margin is far larger. This replaces OP-02's 16-18-cost duelists and OP-01's grind-forever cheap blocks simultaneously.
revised_stage_understanding.early_survival_model: EXP-006 generalizes: a blocker with def<250 dies in ~12s per attacking uoffcr (empirical interval ~1.5s from the 295->654 trace). Therefore the lane-01 block must be def>=322 (char_445_wscoot) so that the queue-clear deadline is set by block-COUNT (route-4 pair at 805/941) rather than blocker death: with ~480-490 eDPS auto-cycle fire (char_4211_snhunt class: 650 atk, 2.3x every 3rd attack) established by ~frame 450-600, the queue route-1 -> route-28 clears every ~205 frames and never exceeds depth 2.
revised_stage_understanding.economy_model: DP = 10 initial + 1.0/s natural (30 frames per DP). Envelope: 34.3 by frame 729, 41.37 by 941, 55 by 1350. The prior plans' bounds embed one fang-class +6 proc (47.3667@941). Legal economy levers never used by failed plans: (1) retreat refund from the [3,3] stub after it solos route-2 (~frame 390, +5 if full refund, rule to be verified); (2) a backfield battery pioneer on a path-free tile (e.g. [9,4], absent from all cluster path_segments): char_420_flamtl (cost 12, +6 DP per 18s auto cycle, first proc ~9s after deploy) yields +6 roughly every 540 frames through the mid-game; (3) deleting the standing medic via def>=322 blockers; (4) merging three ranged responsibilities into one SC_01 deployment.
revised_stage_understanding.merge_discovery: SC_01 [9,2] is the only tile covering C07 (13 routes) AND covers [8,5] (pocket) and [8,0] (all lane-02 leaks). One heavy auto-cycle unit there can own three responsibilities that prior plans paid for separately.
revised_stage_understanding.topology_discovery: IR_01 has a second legal tile, [3,5], upstream on lane-01. A cheap durable block-1 body there (char_322_lmlee: cost 7, 1552 HP, 308 def, 25s redeploy) can dam route-1 alone indefinitely, splitting the pocket queue so downstream block-count and fire deadlines relax by ~200 frames. Prior plans forbade [3,5] openings (CMF-1) but that prohibition targeted replacing the [8,5] opener, not a supplementary upstream dam; verifier adjudicates.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.falsification: If the retreat refund is < ~1 DP, or [9,2] is not deployable (roadblock), or the anchor cannot engage the [8,5] cell as catalogued, the crunch reopens and Plan A degrades toward Plan B's extra concession.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.statement: One heavy auto-cycle unit at [9,2], funded by the stub's retreat refund and established by ~frame 400-500, can simultaneously clear the [8,5] pocket queue, anchor C07 from route-10, and catch C04 tails at [8,0]; combined with a def>=322 dam (no medic), cost-6 duelists, and a backfield battery, the W02 crunch fits inside the verified envelope (35 vs 39.3 by 729 with refund) with route-8 as the single conditional concession.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.falsification: If [3,5] interception of route-1 is ruled illegal after frame ~60-150 (CMF-1 extended by the verifier), or the dam tile proves targetable by anything, the topology collapses to Plan A.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.statement: Splitting lane-01 into an upstream single-enemy dam at [3,5] (lmlee-class, block-1, chip-immune) and a downstream pocket at [8,5] relaxes every pocket fire deadline by ~200 frames (route-3 need only die by 941, and route-1 never pressures block-count), converting the simultaneous prefix into a sequence; the price is one extra early deployment and the route-6 concession.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.falsification: If any upgrade window collides with a live engagement (route-9 train spacing, route-15 at 2727), the transition must slide later; if slide room is absent the plan degrades to Plan A's static formation.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.statement: The auto-cycle killing-block doctrine (OP-04) is sound if deferred: cheap 6-8-cost bodies hold W02, then three planned vacate-first same-tile upgrades ([8,5], [5,1], [6,1]) installed in verified arrival gaps during W03-W05 convert the formation into self-clearing ground for W05/W06 density, all funded by battery cycles plus refunds.
